    out = [row[:] for row in grid]

                if axis == 0:
                    for x in range(min(r, q[0]) + 2, max(r, q[0]) - 1):
                        out[x][c] = 1
                else:
                    for y in range(min(c, q[1]) + 2, max(c, q[1]) - 1):
                        out[r][y] = 1
    return out
'''
